profile: Pinned SQLite 3.47.2, standard limits, native name comparison and schema search order, writable_schema and legacy_alter_table disabled and ignore_check_constraints disabled.
scope: Explicitly named inline CHECK constraints on ordinary and generated appended columns of a resolved ordinary table.

Schema/Alter/AddColumn.role: Append a column with explicitly named inline CHECK constraints.
Schema/Alter/AddColumn.structure: Resolved absolute table, effective STRICT mode, the appended slot, sparse ordered bindings for the exact column operands, the checked ordinary definition and owned ordered inline conditions.
Schema/Alter/AddColumn.conditions: Each appended CHECK in this named domain has an explicit Identifier label and the new column as its owner. Its terms resolve to the prior declared ordinals and the new ordinal of that same table. No live parameter, second relation, implicit rowid, or out-of-scope reference enters the value. Checked folded registrations retain their numbered spellings. Generation operands keep their narrower scope of prior ordinals.
Schema/Alter/AddColumn.meaning: Test the added conditions in declaration order. For existing rows, SQLite validates the combined definition and can atomically refuse it. On subsequent inserts and updates, NULL satisfies CHECK, false fails, and the first failing CHECK supplies the named diagnostic. Keep the existing table and effects of the underlying column definition.
Schema/Alter/AddColumn.externalInterpretation: Apply to the same ordinary table and actual rows, table strictness and transaction state. Existing checks, indices and dependencies retain their native behavior. The appended slot and selected operand bindings belong to the value. No original SQL, parser, context or database object belongs to it.
Schema/Alter/AddColumn.sql: Emit the absolute ALTER TABLE, column clause and one CONSTRAINT quoted-label CHECK (resolved expression) per explicitly named list entry. Emit references by their resolved ordinal and preserve explicit names, ordering and folded registrations.

rules: The new ordinary or generated field is an addressable input to its own CHECK, even though it cannot supply a generation input.

Preserve CHECK order, label spelling, NULL as a success, and typed source slot identity. Old-row refusal has SQLite's generic code 1 message. Future insert or update failure identifies the first failing CHECK with constraint code 19.
Populated STORED addition preserves the native earlier refusal. Empty STORED addition installs its checks, as does a successful VIRTUAL addition.

Reuse the closed scalar role and native numbered registrations. ALTER placement resolves the exact table before construction and does not infer live rows, outcomes or unrelated external catalog definitions.

The separate implicit comparison domain checks admitted spellings. A mismatched implicit binding or a wider uncompiled anonymous expression remains a typed refusal. Naming of other column constraint roles remains open.
observations: Compare exact schema identity, column and CHECK order, catalog mode, rollback and typed rows from both same-named fixture tables.

Distinguish default value or generated value, CHECK input slot, NULL success, native rejection of a previously stored row, first failure label from multiple checks, omitted and explicit insert values and updates of a prior operand.
Observe native parameter names and slots even in a folded condition that can never fail.
Directly construct all finite cases and exercise independently written original SQL against the same pinned engine where analyzed. Compare each result with the independent evaluator.
Compare the appended position and exact selected slot bindings independently of the candidate projection. Continue to observe the complete native heading and the effects of the same prior table.
